task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Simulate time evolution of the 4-site Heisenberg XXZ chain (Jx=Jy=1, Jz=1.07, open boundary) for time t=1.25 in Qiskit using first-order Trotterization with 60 steps. Start from the Neel state and compare <Z_0>(t) against exact evolution with scipy.linalg.expm. Your answer must be the complete working code only, runnable from top to bottom.
